title: Distributional cost-effectiveness and equity-weighted analysis
primary_chapter_title: Economic Evaluation, Affordability, and Health Technology Assessment
purpose: Compares costs, effects, net monetary benefit, access, and equity-weighted value across population groups.
input: `Groups` sheet with group, population size, incremental cost, incremental effect, equity weight, and access rate; `Parameters` sheet with willingness-to-pay threshold.
outputs: Group-level and aggregate NMB, equity-weighted NMB, access-adjusted effects, distribution chart, disparity indicators, and interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
